thread:
evan: spinning up a short proposal to reduce long-lived PM actions and make IC rotation safer. goal: fast decisions, mandatory backups, and automated nudges.

maya: interested. whats the concrete flow?

ev an: oops typo. sketch below — intentionally tight and machine-friendly so bots can enforce.

luc: share it. concise please.

ev an:
```
T0 - PM published: author adds action list. bot creates GH issues with fields: owner, backup, due=10d, risk(low/med/high), mitigation_snippet(1-2 lines). label: postmortem-action + pilot-rapid
T+2d - 20m triage call: owners confirm scope/backups; mark any that need >10d as `roadmap-deferral` with PM sign-off
T+6d - heartbeat: bot posts status to #incidents; owners must update GH issues by EOD (open/blocked/done)
T+10d - closure milestone: actions closed OR moved to roadmap OR escalated with interim mitigation. if risk=high & open -> auto-assign backup and ping oncall lead
T+30d - recurrence check: automatic query for similar incidents in last 90d; if count>=2 -> create recurring-review ticket

IC rotation: monthly. when IC rotates, prev IC leaves a 6-line handoff in PM doc: open actions, mitigations toggled, runbook links, owner contacts, outstanding blockers. new IC must ack in GH comment.

Automation rules:
- bot will block close if risk=high and no mitigation present
- open actions older than 10d auto-escalate to oncall lead and PM
- recurring-detection runs monthly and flags services with >=2 repeats
```

maya: i like the enforcement bits. one ask: add a quick "severity of recurrence" field (none/possible/likely) so reviewers can prioritize.

ev an: sure. add recurrence_severity. also propose a tiny dashboard: open actions by age, % closed <=10d, recurrence_flags by service.

luc: implementation note: GH templates + a small AWS Lambda to parse PM doc -> create issues -> schedule Slack reminders. ops-bot can be the scheduler.

radha: ops-bot can also post example heartbeat table: 
```
PM 1234 status - Day6 heartbeat
- svc-auth: owner=luc, status=open, risk=high, mitigation_snippet="rate-limit toggle", backup=maya
- svc-cache: owner=radha, status=blocked, risk=med, mitigation_snippet="cache-ttl bump", backup=luc
```

ops-bot: scheduled: create_pm_issues_job (next_run 1736012600)

maya: for pilot metrics, track: percent_closed_within_10d, avg_time_to_close, #escalations, #recurrence_flags. set baseline and measure after 4 sprints.

luc: can we require owners to add a single-line "why this matters" to each action? helps PMs prioritize when backloging.

ev an: good idea. add `one_liner_impact` field to GH template.

radha: volunteer to write the GH template + Lambda PR. aiming to pilot on 3 new PMs next sprint.

maya: i'll build the grafana panels and a saved query for recurrence detection.

luc: i'll review the PR.

ev an: thanks team. i'll author the one-pager and post to #incidents once PR is opened. :white_check_mark:
